sources.snippet: Liquid AI announced LFM3 on October 27, 2026, a new generation of open-weight Liquid Foundation Models that brings text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models onto one shared backbone. The first release, detailed in a...

sources.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models
sources.snippet: Liquid AI LFM3 ships 6 open-weight 2B-class models; LFM3-1.7B averages 49.37 across 29 self-reported benchmarks, above Qwen3.5-9B’s 47.24.
